[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using Bioderma Sensibio AR+ Cream for a little over a month, and overall my experience has been mixed. The cream provides good hydration and feels very soothing, especially on days when my skin is irritated from retinol use. It absorbs well, doesn't have a strong scent, and leaves my skin feeling comfortable. However, while it helps calm my skin and reduce dryness, I haven't noticed a significant improvement in my skin barrier. I still experience breakouts and clogged pores, and my skin doesn't seem much more resilient than before. For me, this works better as a soothing moisturizer than as a barrier-repair treatment.If you have sensitive skin and are looking for hydration and comfort, it may be worth trying, but I was hoping for stronger results after using it consistently for over a month.
